summary: postinstall exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: Package presents itself as a date-formatting utility but ships a postinstall.js that runs automatically on npm install and executes shell commands (whoami, hostname/pwd, nslookup) to collect installer-side host identifiers, then POSTs the collected data via curl to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://129.204.76.212:9999/rce-poc over plain HTTP. A DNS lookup of the hostname is also issued via nslookup as a secondary exfiltration channel. Source comments in index.js state in Chinese that the date-formatting functions exist to make the package appear legitimate and that the real logic lives in postinstall.js. Package name resembles common date-formatting utilities.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
